query: EXPLAIN MATCH (s:V01 {uid:'V01:S06'}),(t:V01 {uid:'V01:ST01'}) RETURN s.uid AS space,t.uid AS street,labels(s) AS spaceLabels,labels(t) AS referenceLabels,s.geometryJson AS spaceGeometry,t.geometryJson AS streetGeometry,s.groundZM AS spaceLevel,s.geometryVersion AS spaceVersion,t.geometryVersion AS streetVersion
